description: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-E (%) metric for three different LLaMA model sizes—LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B—with four distinct configurations of SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning), as indicated by the legend: “no SFT” (light blue with diagonal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀” (orange with horizontal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple with diagonal stripes), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (pink with diagonal stripes). The horizontal axis displays the model sizes, while the vertical axis represents the CoLeG-E (%) value, ranging from 0 to 50 in increments of 10, using a linear scale. For each model size, four bars are grouped together, each corresponding to one SFT configuration. The “no SFT” bar is consistently the shortest across all model sizes, with approximate values of 4% for LLaMA-2-13B and 26% for LLaMA-2-70B. The “+ SFT on D₀” bar shows a moderate increase, reaching approximately 20% for LLaMA-2-13B and 45% for LLaMA-2-70B. The “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” bar is taller than the previous, reaching approximately 29% for LLaMA-2-13B and 49% for LLaMA-2-70B. The tallest bars correspond to “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂,” with approximate values of 31% for LLaMA-2-13B and 51% for LLaMA-2-70B. The bars are arranged in groups by model size, with no explicit sorting of the bars within each group, and none of the bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and pattern coding.
